rules: Upstream synchronization may only replace upstream_knowledge.
Immediate learning promotion writes immutable local objects and never edits Git-tracked Skills.
Only periodic sanitized knowledge archives and functional candidates may update main.
Upstream learning must be promoted as a local overlay.
Bilingual terminology is local routing metadata and must not rewrite upstream files.
Only repository terms and official CWE terms may canonicalize report weakness classes.
Community-discovered terms are search hints until explicitly promoted.
Report ingestion artifacts are versioned local derivatives; original reports remain read-only.
Machine-extracted report findings remain drafts until evidence review.
The hub-wide learning policy applies to every local Skill update and every upstream supplement.
Skill learning may only promote target-independent rules reusable within the declared Skill scope.
Domain vocabulary may improve recall and ranking but must never gate structural graph generation.
